description: This file defines the PerformanceTracker class, which represents a performance tracking entity in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties such as trainer name, dates, status, and related employee data, with ORM annotations for database mapping and methods for accessing and modifying these properties.

classes.name: PerformanceTracker
classes.description: Entity class representing performance tracking records with attributes for tracking information, associations with employees, and ORM mappings.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the performance tracker.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the performance tracker.

methods.name: getTrackerName
methods.description: Returns the name of the performance tracker.

methods.name: setTrackerName
methods.description: Sets the name of the performance tracker.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the tracker was added.

methods.name: setAddedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the tracker was added.

methods.name: getModifiedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the tracker was last modified, if any.

methods.name: setModifiedDate
methods.description: Sets the last modified date for the tracker.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the tracker (e.g., deleted or not).

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the tracker.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the employee associated with this performance tracker.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an employee with this performance tracker.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerReviewer
methods.description: Returns the reviewers associated with this performance tracker.

methods.name: setPerformanceTrackerReviewer
methods.description: Sets the reviewers for this performance tracker.

methods.name: getAddedBy
methods.description: Returns the employee who added this tracker.

methods.name: setAddedBy
methods.description: Sets the employee who added this tracker.
